protocol.hypothesis: A 0.3 s estimated low-motion dwell before feet-only release prevents disturbed sole displacement and gripper recontact, while preserving nominal recovery by 9 s.
protocol.intervention: Opt-in release timing gate: retain original braced controller until estimated maximum joint speed <0.1 rad/s, brace-wrist speed <0.03 m/s and both sole tangential speeds <0.02 m/s continuously for 0.3 s. Then execute the unchanged first-command feasibility gate and return controller.
protocol.parameter_justification: All thresholds and dwell are copied from the preceding recovery success screens, with no parameter fit; hardware thresholds remain unmeasured assumptions.
protocol.baseline: Reuse the independently reviewed scheduled-release nominal and pulse rollouts; verify source/model hashes and exact estimated trajectory agreement before 5.2 s.
protocol.selection_condition: Existing 90 N world +y reaching-wrist pulse at 4.5–4.8 s
protocol.reserved_validation: Nominal without pulse, evaluated only after saving the pulse decision; no retuning.
protocol.falsification: Fail if corrected pulse does not finish standing recovery by 9 s with the original 0.3 s dwell, robot table load <5 N and maximum post-request sole displacement <5 mm; also fail if nominal loses its baseline success. No improvement by indefinitely deferring return.
protocol.observation: Only State from default_sense(seed=17), including estimated base pose and existing ideal velocity/joint channels, enters the release gate. Physical contacts and true motion are scoring only.

summary.command_torque_tracking_definition: Actuator minus feedforward includes PD response; not a torque-servo tracking error.
summary.observation: MuJoCoPlant.read -> default_sense(seed=17) -> State; true poses/contacts only in recording and scoring

command_response.note: The 30 mm reach screen is wider than the 20 mm target step; zero acquisition time does not measure tracking response.
